property_summary: The reference contract always returns true when the external call to caddress succeeds for every recipient; the mutant may revert because from.call invokes transferFrom on the from address instead, which likely has no such function.
change_summary: Change the call from caddress.call to from.call, altering which address executes the external call and thus which contract's transferFrom is invoked, which can change the success or failure of the call.
